signatures.name: tit_for_tat_reciprocity_pd
signatures.description: In PD, the player's cooperate decision tracks the opponent's previous-round move: P(cooperate | opp cooperated last round) > P(cooperate | opp defected last round). Operationalized as a positive Pearson correlation between prev_opp_coop_pd and player_cooperate across PD rounds 2-10. The headline reciprocity signature.

signatures.name: above_chance_coordination_bos
signatures.description: In BoS, the player matches the opponent's action (lands on either equilibrium F-F or J-J) at a rate above chance (0.5). Camerer 2003 reports humans converge to 0.55+ within 10 rounds against alternating bots.

signatures.name: non_zero_cooperation_pd
signatures.description: Humans cooperate at non-trivial rates in repeated PD against TFT (typically 0.40-0.70). A pure-defect agent would score 0 here; this signature fires if cooperation rate is significantly above 0.10.
